explanation: A data model is used to capture the facts and relationships that matter for the database. Physical storage choices and process logic are separate design concerns, so option A is the best answer.

options.text: It identifies the facts and relationships that need to be stored.
It decides exactly how data will be indexed and physically laid out on disk.
It defines the user interface screens for entering data.
It replaces the need to understand business rules before design begins.

prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of a data model in database design?
